knowledge.textEn: With independent identically biased basis choices, matching probability is p squared plus(1−p) squared; bias retains more detections but can weaken finite-sample testing.

stages.description: 以「BB84：基底篩選與抽樣資源」研究 Shor and Preskill: Simple proof of security of BB84 所涉及的機制。保留來源版本與查閱日期，案例名稱不把合成輸入變成真實設備資料。 兩端獨立選基底且同分布時，匹配機率為p²+(1−p)²；偏置可增加保留比例，但測試基底樣本不足會影響有限長度估計。 畫出式中各物理量或事件所對應的界面，再建立下列合成輸入表： 合成有效偵測100萬次；公平基底p=0.5，改為p=0.9；只計匹配，不把保留位元稱安全金鑰。
stages.descriptionEn: Investigate BB84: basis sifting and test resources using mechanisms documented by Shor and Preskill: Simple proof of security of BB84. Record source edition and access date; the named case does not turn synthetic inputs into real equipment data. With independent identically biased basis choices, matching probability is p squared plus(1−p) squared; bias retains more detections but can weaken finite-sample testing. Map each quantity or event to an interface, then construct this synthetic input table: Synthetic one million detections withp=0.5, changed top=0.9; count matched bases without calling sifted bits secure keys.
